topic: ci/smoke-test — npm pack tarball install validates the published package
decision: CI must include an npm pack smoke test that installs the produced tarball into a blank temp project and runs quorum init, advisor brief, check, compass map, and commit --list. This catches raw .ts import errors, missing-await issues, and broken exports that unit tests cannot detect.
key_insight: Unit tests pass even when the published package is broken. An npm pack smoke test is the only gate that catches import/export and CLI wiring bugs before release.
alternatives_considered: Run smoke test only in auto-release.yml, not CI
rejected_reason: Smoke testing only at release means broken PRs are merged before the issue is caught — it must run on every PR
